# Project docs

Open a folder's INDEX.md to see its files. Every folder has one.

## All folders

- [handoffs/](handoffs/INDEX.md) — **Handoffs**: Live task files. Open ones are loaded at session start.
- [images/](images/INDEX.md) — **images**: (no description — add one)
- [knowledge/](knowledge/INDEX.md) — **Knowledge**: Lasting, tested facts about this project, grouped by kind. Open a folder index to drill in.
  - [knowledge/architecture/](knowledge/architecture/INDEX.md) — **Architecture**: How the system is built: main parts, data flow, key design choices, and where code lives.
  - [knowledge/decisions/](knowledge/decisions/INDEX.md) — **Decisions**: Decisions grouped by area of the system (one file per area). Each entry is dated: what was chosen, over what, and why. Never rewritten, only superseded.
  - [knowledge/gotchas/](knowledge/gotchas/INDEX.md) — **Gotchas**: Traps, bugs and errors grouped by area of the system (one file per area), with symptom, cause and fix. Read the area's file before changing that area.
  - [knowledge/models/](knowledge/models/INDEX.md) — **Models**: Data models, schemas, entities, and APIs between parts. Field meanings and invariants.
- [reviews/](reviews/INDEX.md) — **Reviews**: Independent Codex reviews of plans and big diffs (one file per review), with the triage of each finding in the task decisions. Read before changing an area a review covered.
- [skills/](skills/INDEX.md) — **Skills**: Project-only skills, loaded natively by Claude Code and Codex.
  - [skills/add-agent-tool/](skills/add-agent-tool/INDEX.md) — **add-agent-tool**: Add or change a tool the ReAct agent can call (schema, code, observation, tests, tracing, eval). Use whenever agent/tools.py or prompts/tools.json changes.
  - [skills/codex-review/](skills/codex-review/INDEX.md) — **codex-review**: Get an independent Codex review of a plan or a diff, then log each finding as fixed or rejected. Use before merging a big change (new module, agent loop, ingest) or when the user asks for a review.
  - [skills/debug-trace/](skills/debug-trace/INDEX.md) — **debug-trace**: Find why one answer was wrong, starting from its failure label and trace, and choose what to fix. Use when an eval question fails or an /ask answer looks wrong.
  - [skills/prompt-change/](skills/prompt-change/INDEX.md) — **prompt-change**: Change a prompt or a tool description safely. Use for any edit under src/corpusqa/prompts/.
  - [skills/run-eval/](skills/run-eval/INDEX.md) — **run-eval**: Run the eval (retrieval, smoke, tune, held-out or the whole golden set) against a running server and read the report. Use after any change to prompts, tools, retrieval, chunking or caps, and before calling such a change done.

## Files in docs/

- [backlog.md](backlog.md) — **Backlog — agreed work waiting to be built**: Work the user agreed to but asked to build later, together with related work. Each item says why, what to build, where in the code, and what must stay the same. Open - 4 choose RRF k (60 or 20); 5 add --no-fields to eval-retrieval when a plain variant is needed again; 6 the Codex review fixes of the agent harness and corpus tools (#5 network errors fixed, #1 tool time, #4 contains, #9 failed calls traced thinly, the Lows); 7 check the learned date window against the evals and the created-date wording; 8 search passage size (open question); 9 accept quoted filter argument names; 10 stop sooner when the records do not hold the answer (and the step-10 note); 11 a code check of the citing rule; 13 eval a new corpus (question file option); 14 one judged eval run; 15 duplicate-call checks; 16 AI dev setup questions (ship the harness, planning records, a prompt-version lock test); 17 shared own-id values (a check that two documents do not carry the same id: flag-and-tell or strict quarantine, user decides). Done - 1 tunable fusion weights + per-question recall; 2 the agent's corpus tools; 3 field values in every chunk header; 12 removed the trace and fresh-clone-check keys. Read before starting work on retrieval, the agent or the evals. Never start an item on your own; the user says when.
- [eval-log.md](eval-log.md) — **Eval log — runs, findings and the changes they led to**: Every end-to-end eval of the agent (2026-10-17), newest first, for the final report - the final run (milestone final, all 79 questions, 4 at once: answerable F1 0.945, 10 of 11 no-answer questions cite nothing, 0 errors, slowest 59 s); smoke runs 1-4 (10 questions; run 1 found search that never says "nothing found", no stop rule or visible budget and no thinking; runs 2-4 kept the stop rule + step count, exact search and thinking HIGH; a table of all four), tune runs T1-T3 (30 questions, thinking HIGH vs LOW vs off, and the problems every setting shares) and T4-T5 (agent.md v7 + the first search, HIGH vs LOW; HIGH 28 of 30 correct and 4 of 4 abstains, chosen), the held-out milestones v7-first-search-high and -low (aggregates only; HIGH answerable F1 0.948 and 7 of 7 abstains), and the answer judge's calibration (prompt judge v1 agrees with the hand checks on 99.3% of 590 facts, kappa 0.90, $2.78). Each entry gives the setup, the scores, what went wrong and why with the evidence, and the changes it led to. Read before changing search, the agent prompt, the loop limits or the thinking settings, and when writing the report.
- [prompt-log.md](prompt-log.md) — **Prompt log — why each part of the agent's prompts changed**: One entry per change to the agent's prompt files (`src/corpusqa/prompts/agent.md`, `tools.json`): what changed, the reason in principle, and how it is measured. agent.md v7 tells the agent that the service searches the question as written before its first step (the code-side first search); v6 adds "# How to search" to avoid anchoring bias and searching only in the question's own wording; v5 tightened citing and banned handles in the answer text; v4 added the stop rule and the step budget. v5-v7 were measured together in tune runs T4-T5 and kept. Read before changing a prompt, and when writing the report. Evidence and scores are in `docs/eval-log.md`.
